summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code, per your instructions. Changes: monai/data/grid_dataset.py adds PatchIter (prepends the channel whole-dimension entry, normalizes start_pos with ensure_tuple, validates mode via NumpyPadMode, delegates to iter_patch with copy_back off) and reworks GridPatchDataset (dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; np.ceil worker split; transform applied per patch via apply_transform with map_items=False). The PatchDataset docstring float alias is fixed and the math import removed. monai/data/utils.py makes iter_patch yield (patch, coords) pairs, with the coordinate offset computed there, updates its docstring, and makes set_rnd skip double-underscore attributes. monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter. docs/source/data.rst gets a PatchIter autodoc entry. tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds test_shape and test_loading_array, with the pinned values from the spec. Choices to review: the missing-len() NotImplementedError is raised in GridPatchDataset.__init__ rather than __iter__; test_loading_array calls set_determinism(1234) both in setUp and at its start. Not verified: pytest was not run, so the RandShiftIntensity pinned values are unconfirmed. Lines over 120 characters remain at utils.py 231-233, in the pre-existing get_valid_patch_size docstring, which I left untouched. Nothing was committed.
